'''"Salty" Sharp''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Resistance trooper|soldier]] who served as a [[sergeant]] in the [[Resistance Army|army]] of the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. After surviving the First Order's [[Battle of Oetchi]], he was amongst the Resistance personnel who managed to reach an [[Crait outpost|outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Crait]]. Sharp was deployed into the trenches outside of the outpost in order to hold off the First Order once they [[Battle of Crait|attacked]].

==Biography==
Sharp,<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> known by the nickname "Salty," was a [[sergeant]] in the [[Resistance Army|army]] of the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]].<ref name="TLJ" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> Sharp was amongst those Resistance members who survived the [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] by the First Order on the [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] after it [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuated]] from the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]]. Along with the other survivors, the sergeant arrived at the [[Crait outpost|abandoned outpost]] on the planet [[Crait]]<ref name="TLJ" /> in a [[U-55 orbital loadlifter]] [[transport]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and was amongst the troops who manned the outpost's trenches in preparation for the First Order's assault.<ref name="TLJ" />

[[File:Sharp_on_Crait.png|thumb|left|250px|Sharp fought the First Order on Crait.]]
[[General]] [[Caluan Ematt]]<ref name="TLJ" /><ref name="TLJVD" /> climbed out over the trench next to Sharp in order to try and spot the First Order forces with a pair<ref name="TLJ" /> of [[TE4.4 field quadnoculars|quadnoculars]]<ref name="TLJ" /><ref name="TLJVD" /> and in doing so disrupted some of the [[salt]] that covered Crait's surface, revealing the red soil beneath. Curious about the salt, Sharp tasted a small amount and then confirmed its nature to the [[Unidentified Resistance soldier|soldier next to him]]. The First Order [[Battle of Crait|attacked]] soon after, but ultimately those Resistance members who survived the battle escaped on the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Sharp had fair skin, [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s and gray [[hair]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Equipment==
He wore a brown [[Clothing|poncho]] and brown pants and [[boot]]s on Crait, also carrying a [[hepta-mag ammunition carrier belt]] and a [[Armor|helmet]] marked with his rank.<ref name="TLJVD" /> He used a [[EL-16HFE blaster rifle]] while battling the First Order.<ref name="TLJ" /><ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Salty" Sharp was portrayed by key assistant second director [[Matthew Sharp]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]],<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> although he was first shown in the "Worlds of The Last Jedi" featurette released on [[December 9]].<ref name="Worlds of TLJ">{{SWYouTube|zIauywtvcjI|Star Wars: The Last Jedi | Worlds of The Last Jedi|sw_url=video/worlds-of-the-last-jedi}}</ref> He was only identified by his nickname in the film's credits,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received a surname in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy]]'' — "[[Part One (Rebuild the Galaxy)|Part One]]", "Salty" Sharp was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Part One (Rebuild the Galaxy)">{{RebuildTheGalaxy|Part One}}</ref>
